purpose: Paired short diagnosis, not round2 product training
selection: first sorted main train source ids with both labeled modes; mixed odd ordinal uses wide, even uses local; same roots per size
architecture: 13-256-256-256-6 SiLU; final Linear weight/bias zero in both heads
loss: mean sum six squared normalized teacher joint errors
batch: full selected subset, same rows every update
small_diagnostic_gate: A=64/64 for each 64-row cell; not generalization
validation: all 3600 rows, all families/modes and missing teachers retained
